title: run_tests.gd wires test_view_interaction.gd but the spec never lists it in code map, tasks, or review order
evidence:
+		"res://tests/test_view_interaction.gd",
+- `tests/` -- EDIT/NEW: sim contract tests (replay, qos, sla, flow, view-purity, editor-preview) + runner list
+- [x] `tests/test_view_purity.gd` + `tests/test_editor_preview.gd` -- view-noise hash invariance; preview determinism -- A1 + QoL
detail: A 27-check suite file (per its EXPECTED_CHECKS := 27) is wired into the runner, but the spec's task checkboxes, code-map enumeration, and suggested review order omit it entirely — scope drift unrecorded.
recommended_fix: Add test_view_interaction.gd to the spec's task list, code map, and review order, or log the omission in the Spec Change Log.

title: Hardcoded set_lanes 'pipe': 1 after a single add_pipe — legs only exercise size/missing-class validation if ids are 1-based
evidence:
+	sim.apply_command({"cmd": "add_pipe", "a": 1, "b": 2})
+	var before: Array = (sim.bundle_for_pair(1, 2).alloc as Array).duplicate()
+	sim.apply_command({"cmd": "set_lanes", "pipe": 1, "alloc": [50, 30],
+		"cls_lane": {"email": 1, "streaming": 0}})
detail: Exactly one pipe exists. If ids are 0-based, 'pipe': 1 is unknown-pipe, so the labeled 'wrong array size' and 'missing class' legs re-test unknown-pipe; tests still pass either way (coverage silently differs).
recommended_fix: Fetch the id dynamically via sim.bundle_for_pair(1, 2).id as sibling tests (_set_lanes_command, _fresh_pipe) already do.

title: Check-count gate silently skips any file without EXPECTED_CHECKS (-1 fallback)
evidence:
+		var pinned: Variant = inst.get("EXPECTED_CHECKS")
+		var expected: int = int(pinned) if pinned != null else -1
+		if expected >= 0 and ran_checks != expected:
detail: test_base's comment promises 'friction on purpose', but the -1 fallback makes the r2-B2 abort-eats-checks gate opt-in per file; a future unpinned test file reintroduces the exact hole.
recommended_fix: Fail (or at least warn loudly) when a runner-listed script lacks EXPECTED_CHECKS instead of silently skipping the gate.

title: test_no_sim.gd → test_world.gd rename discards the script uid instead of preserving it
evidence:
diff --git a/tests/test_no_sim.gd.uid b/tests/test_no_sim.gd.uid
-uid://blgkgikxo7bsg
diff --git a/tests/test_world.gd.uid b/tests/test_world.gd.uid
+uid://bm510mrht41c
detail: The deleted uid://blgkgikxo7bsg is replaced by a fresh uid://bm510mrht41c; harmless here (referenced by path in run_tests.gd) but any uid reference to the renamed script would break.
recommended_fix: On rename, carry the old .uid content to tests/test_world.gd.uid so the script's stable identity survives.
